what: Kichink's own website states that opening a store has no cost, with Kichink charging a per-transaction commission starting at 15%.
verbatim_snippet: "Abrir tu tienda NO TIENE COSTO. Kichink sólo cobra una comisión por transacción a partir del 15%."
date: Copyright footer reads "@2025 Kichink Servicios S.A. de C.V."
notes: kichink.com returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on direct fetch. Content preserved in Google search index. The 15% starting commission represents a significant increase from earlier rates: 7.5% cited in 2013–2017 press and interviews (F-02, F-P04), and 9.5% cited by MarketHax circa 2020–2023 (F-04). Self-positioning statement (pricing differentiator).
